title.narrative: Integrated Multi-Sectoral Humanitarian Response to Address the Priority Needs of Internally Displaced Populations in East Borena Zone, Oromia Region

description.narrative: ltpgtIDP communities living in Dhas and Arero woredas of East Borena Zone of the Oromia Region in Ethiopia are displaced due to insecurity related to armed group activities in the zone and intercommunal conflict along the Oromia-Somali bordering areas of Somali region. This includes more than 267,364 IDPs that currently face multi-sectoral critical gaps in services. So far 10,336 individuals have been reported to be displaced in Arero. In Dhas woredas, the total of 56,332 ltspangtindividualslt/spangtltspangt lt/spangtltspangtwere displaced respectively.lt/spangtlt/pgtltpgtIDP site living is characterized by overcrowded space, critically affecting the ability to practice key hygiene behavioral practices. IDPs are lacking access to adequate and safe water sources, basic nutrition and shelter support. The compounding effects of these factors result in IDP communities being highly vulnerable to disease outbreaks and facing increased exposure to protection risks, access to inadequate WASH services including overutilization of the facilities. ltbrgtThe partnership, composed of WHH and Action for Development (AFD) aims to address key gaps in service provision through the delivery of an integrated and multi-sectoral response for IDPs focusing on WASH, Shelter, CwG, Nutrition and General Protection in Dhas and Arero woredas.ltbrgtThe intervention will contribute towards achieving the strategic priority I of the call, by delivering services that ensure improved access to safe and adequate WASH facilities, delivering multi-sectoral shelter and non-food items, providing nutrition case management and MPCA in the form of monthly assistance to target the most basic household and pressing needs, as well as facilitating general protection. To ensure successful and effective delivery, the project will be implemented jointly. WHH will be responsible for overall monitoring and compliance related issues such as ensuring adherence to contractual obligations, guidelines and procedures are adhered to and visibility and communications are addressed. ltspangtWHH will be the administrative grant holder and lt/spangtltspangtwill also directly implement the Nutrition, MPCA and Protection components, oversee the overall operation, conduct follow up and field monitoring along with the partner AFD who will focus on WASH and Shelter. lt/spangtlt/pgtltpgtThere will be regular meetings with AFD and key stakeholders in the implementation woredas. WHH as lead agency will compile narrative and financial reports (including verification of expenditure support documents) from the joint effort and submit quality report to EHF/OCHA. AFD will be leading the activities on WASH and Shelter of this proposed project.ltbrgtlt/pgt
